errors.zone_selection_required: {hint} is the literal query parameter '?zone=<entry_id>'; keep it unchanged. 'zones' and 'entry_id' are field names in the reply.
errors.invalid_verbosity: tldr_only, normal and verbose are literal values; keep them.
errors.feedback_value: 'correct' and 'incorrect' are literal values; keep them in quotes.
errors.action_value: 'accept' and 'dismiss' are literal values; keep them in quotes.
errors.action_or_feedback_required: action, feedback, accept, dismiss, correct and incorrect are literal field names/values; keep them.
errors.suggestion_key_required: suggestion_key is a literal field name; keep it.
errors.resume_pending: {mode} is the thermostat mode (heat, cool, ...) or 'none' when unknown; translate the mode words in the select.
errors.resume_done: {mode} is the thermostat mode (heat, cool, ...) or 'none' (then N/A).
